info.title: Ignition HTTP API
info.description:
### About this page
This specification covers all public HTTP API endpoints for the Ignition platform and currently
installed modules. It is intended to be used by developers to understand the capabilities and
data formats used by the API. This documentation is generated from the
[OpenAPI](https://www.openapis.org/) specification document which is available in JSON format
[here](/openapi.json).

post.description: Generates a key and hash pair suitable for a new API Token. Clients should store the key somewhere safe, such as a password manager or secrets manager. The key is the credential that the client will include with each request for authentication purposes. The hash is a secure digest of the key and should be sent to Ignition as the token hash when creating a new API key. WARNING: it is strongly recommended to call this API using https, otherwise the security of the token could be compromised.

403.description: The request does not have the required write permissions.

500.description: A server error occurred while trying to generate the API Token.

200.description: Success. Returns a JSON encoding of the generated API Token.

key.title: Key
key.description: The raw API key that the client will include with each request for authentication purposes. Clients should store the key somewhere safe, such as a password manager or secrets manager.

hash.title: Hash
hash.description: A secure digest of the key which should be sent to Ignition as the token hash when creating a new API Token. Clients can safely discard this value once a new API Token is created with this hash.

get.description: Generates a *.gwbk file that can be downloaded.

parameters.name: includePeerLocal
parameters.description:
In a redundant gateway environment, set this parameter to 'true' to retrieve local-specific files from the
redundant peer over the gateway network. These files will be stored in the .gwbk alongside the local-specific
files from this gateway.

500.description: A server error occurred while creating the .gwbk file

post.description: Processes and restores a *.gwbk file on this gateway. The gateway will then be restarted.

parameters.name: restoreDisabled
parameters.description: If `true`, all projects, database connections, OPC connections, etc will be disabled upon restart. Default is `false`

parameters.name: disableTempProjectBackup
parameters.description: If `true`, the projects dir will not have a temporary backup created during the restore process. Default is `false`

parameters.name: renameEnabled
parameters.description: If `true` will allow overriding the name of the gateway before it is restored. Default is `false`

parameters.name: newName
parameters.description: The new gateway name to use on restore.

parameters.name: restoreLocal
parameters.description:
Set this parameter to `true` to restore local-specific files on the gateway. These files will be restored to the
data/config/local folder and the data/config/resources/local folder. Note that existing files in these folders
will be deleted. Default value is `false`.

requestBody.description: The contents of the *.gwbk file as a stream of bytes.

400.description: The .gwbk is from an Ignition version that cannot be restored in this gateway, or the .gwbk does not contain a valid version.

403.description: Gateway restoration is not allowed against a redundant backup gateway.

500.description: A server occurred when attempting to apply the restoration file.

get.description: A list of all "healthy" (non-quarantined) modules on this Ignition Gateway.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The number of items to skip before returning results.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description:
The name of a field to sort by. Use `asc(fieldName)` or `desc(fieldName)`
to specify the sort direction as ascending or descending, respectively.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: A search string to filter items by. Terms separated by whitespace.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter items by field name, using format like `fieldName[op]=value` where `op` is one of: `eq` (equals), `ne` (not equals), `cn` (contains), `sw` (starts with), `ew` (ends with), `gt` (greater than), `gte` (greater than or equal), `lt` (less than), `lte` (less than or equal), `rgx` (regular expression).

faultCause.description: For modules that fail to load, this is the provided fault cause.

exception.description: For modules that fail to load, this is the exception thrown.

faultTime.description: For modules that fail to load, this is the time of the fault.

licenseState.description: Module license state. Only available on fully loaded modules.

matching.description: The number of items matching the filter and/or search criteria

limit.description: The maximum number of items to return, as specified in the query parameter

offset.description: The number of items to skip before starting to return items, as specified in the query parameter

live_findings: ALL /data/eam/api/v1/* answer 403 "This operation can only be performed when EAM is configured as a controller." until module-settings.installMode is flipped to Controller via config-resource PUT (live-proven; jar com.inductiveautomation.eam ships installed but NotInstalled by default)
trial license DOES run EAM once installMode=Controller (task force dispatch executed; blocked only when trial expired: "Trial timer is expired")
history item shape live-captured: {taskId, taskName (+" (forced)"), taskStart, taskEnd (epoch ms), target, level (Failed|...), detail, taskType (backup|...)}

task definitions are config resources: POST array body /data/api/v1/resources/com.inductiveautomation.eam/eam-tasks; profile.type enum has 11 task types; scheduleMode enum Immediate|AtTime|AtDelay|Scheduled|SuspendedByFailover|OnDemand; eam_backup settings {targetGateways, targetGroups, concurrentBackups, forceBackups}
task execution requires a GNET-connected agent target — controller-self backup ("_controller") failed: "Gateway network for agent '_controller' is currently not connected"
GET /data/eam/api/v1/storage/archived-backups requires serverids query param (400 without)
